guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Generate and validate Japanese output deterministically; stale or manually edited views fail closed.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The paired checker regenerates expected Japanese output and rejects appended hand edits.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Require executable active and no-active parity tests rather than keyword or documentation presence.

risk.detail: A derived localized view can drift from canonical facts; deterministic regeneration, paired validation, and byte-preservation tests bound that risk.

observedIssues.fact: Cockpit Status had no executable Japanese derived view or freshness validator.
observedIssues.decision: Add an on-demand projection from canonical rendering plus a paired fail-closed checker, without persisting a second lifecycle artifact.
observedIssues.resolution: Active and no-active Japanese views now localize chrome, preserve machine facts, and pass executable parity and stale-output tests.
observedIssues.followUp: Complete PR, Hosted CI, merge, closure, and branch cleanup before JA-PR-001.

observedIssues.fact: The first real Make round-trip failed because timestamp normalization recognized only the English Generated At label; the in-memory fixture used a placeholder and missed the defect.
observedIssues.decision: Normalize both canonical and Japanese labels and strengthen the Japanese stale test with a real ISO timestamp.
observedIssues.resolution: The real generate/check Make pair and all focused tests pass; the plan records that fixture-only evidence is insufficient.
observedIssues.followUp: Retain a real Make round-trip in verification for future localized generated views.
